subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should trusted HTTP callers be allowed to invoke the existing Gateway update.run self-update flow, and should that be done by expanding admin-http-rpc instead of adding a bespoke POST /admin/update endpoint?
rationale: The code path exists, but exposing host package-manager update and restart orchestration over HTTP changes the operator trust boundary and should not be chosen by automation.

options.title: Expose update.run through admin HTTP RPC
options.body: Approve a narrow allowlist expansion in the existing default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin with security docs and tests for trusted private ingress.

options.title: Keep HTTP update execution blocked
options.body: Leave update execution on WebSocket/CLI control-plane surfaces and keep admin HTTP RPC limited to observability such as update.status.

options.title: Design a separate endpoint
options.body: Sponsor a new POST /admin/update contract only if maintainers want request and response semantics that differ materially from Gateway RPC.

recommendation.title: Expose update.run through admin HTTP RPC
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow allowlist expansion in the existing default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin with security docs and tests for trusted private ingress.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest shared owner for both update.run and the admin HTTP RPC boundary.
